title: Basketball Free Throw with Dynamic Difficulty
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a 3D basketball free throw game using Three.js with dynamic difficulty scaling. Load the GLTFLoader from a CDN.

## Scene Setup
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 12), looking toward (0, 4, -5)
- Lighting: AmbientLight (0xffffff, 0.5) + DirectionalLight (0xffffff, 0.8) at (5, 10, 5)
- Court floor: A large flat box (40x0.2x30) at y=0, brown color (0x8B4513)
- Basketball hoop: A torus (ring) with inner radius 0.6, tube radius 0.05, color orange (0xFF6600), positioned at (0, 3.05, -5). Add a vertical pole (cylinder, radius 0.1, height 3.05) at (0, 1.525, -5.5) colored gray. Add a backboard (box 1.8x1.2x0.1) at (0, 3.5, -5.6) colored white.
- Basketball: A sphere with radius 0.24, color (0xFF8C00), starting at (0, 2, 8) — the free throw line position.
- Load the 3D asset 'BarramundiFish.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale it to (0.8, 0.8, 0.8) and position it at (3, 0.5, -3) as a mascot/spectator fish that reacts to scores. It should bob up and down gently with a sine wave animation.

## Physics & Ball Mechanics
- Implement simple projectile physics with gravity = -9.81 m/s².
- The ball follows a parabolic arc when shot. Track position with ballVelocity {x, y, z} and update each frame: pos += vel * dt, vel.y += gravity * dt.
- Collision detection: When ball y < 0.24 (floor), bounce with restitution 0.6 (vel.y *= -0.6) and friction (vel.x *= 0.8, vel.z *= 0.8). Stop ball if speed < 0.3.
- Scoring: Ball passes through hoop if |ball.x - hoop.x| < 0.5 AND |ball.z - hoop.z| < 0.5 AND |ball.y - hoop.y| < 0.3 while ball is moving downward (vel.y < 0). Score only once per shot.

## Aiming & Shooting
- Show a power bar on the left side of the screen (DOM element, vertical bar 30px wide, 200px tall). Fill level indicates shot power (5 to 15 m/s launch speed).
- Press and hold SPACEBAR to charge power. Power increases from 0% to 100% over 2 seconds, then cycles back. Release SPACEBAR to shoot.
- Use LEFT/RIGHT arrow keys to aim horizontally. Aiming adjusts the launch angle left/right by ±0.05 radians per keypress. Display current aim offset in the HUD.
- Launch angle vertical: fixed at 55 degrees from horizontal.
- After shooting, ball becomes active (physics simulation). After ball stops or goes out of bounds (|x|>15 or |z|>20 or y<-2), reset ball to free throw line after 2 seconds.

## Dynamic Difficulty
- Start at difficulty level 1. After every 2 consecutive makes, increase difficulty by 1 (max 5). After every 2 consecutive misses, decrease difficulty by 1 (min 1).
- Difficulty effects:
  - Level 1: Hoop stays still, no wind
  - Level 2: Wind adds +0.5 m/s in x direction to ball velocity each frame
  - Level 3: Wind increases to +1.0 m/s, hoop sways left-right (amplitude 0.3, period 3s)
  - Level 4: Wind is random (-1.5 to 1.5), hoop sways (amplitude 0.5, period 2s)
  - Level 5: Wind random (-2 to 2), hoop sways (amplitude 0.7, period 1.5s), backboard shrinks to 1.2x0.8

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: 'Score: X / Y' showing makes out of total shots
- Top-center: 'Difficulty: N' with N from 1-5, colored green(1) to red(5)
- Top-right: 'Streak: +N' or 'Streak: -N' for consecutive makes/misses
- Power bar on left side with percentage label
- A 'Reset Game' button at bottom-center that resets all stats

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- score: number of successful baskets
- totalShots: total shots taken
- difficulty: current difficulty level (1-5)
- consecutiveMakes: current consecutive makes count
- consecutiveMisses: current consecutive misses count
- ballPosition: {x, y, z}
- ballVelocity: {x, y, z}
- ballActive: boolean (true when ball is in flight)
- power: current power level 0-100
- aimOffset: horizontal aim offset in radians
- hoopPosition: {x, y, z} current hoop position
- windSpeed: current wind value
- fishLoaded: boolean, true when the fish model has loaded
- fishPosition: {x, y, z}
- gameTime: elapsed time in seconds
- lastShotResult: 'none' | 'made' | 'missed'

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Gravity = -9.81 m/s². Ball projectile motion with parabolic trajectory. Floor bounce restitution = 0.6. Ball radius = 0.24. Hoop at height 3.05m. Free throw distance ~13m (z=8 to z=-5). Wind applied as acceleration on x-axis depending on difficulty level.
